messages:
anna_csm: Quick prep: Vega tenant onboarding tomorrow 08:00 PT. Drafted a compact runbook focused on prefill, cache warmups, batching/stream toggles, and a single-question feedback capture. Please ack and add any gating checks.

tom_sre: Ack. Ops notes: prefill top-12 prompts to KV, warm caches for 20s TTL. Start with batching OFF for first 8m, then enable batch_size=5, batch_window_ms=180. If p50 latency jumps > 300ms after a step -> revert and set batch_size=1 + disable streaming.

rachel_te: Runtime toggles we'll expose per-tenant:
```yaml
tenant_toggle:
  enable_streaming: true
  batch_size: 5
  batch_window_ms: 180
  cache_ttl_seconds: 20
  kv_prefix: vega/$TENANT
```
Note: for embedding-heavy flows set cache_ttl_seconds=90.

jess_pm: Renewal watch rule proposal: if week-1 DAU < 14% forecast AND avg_error_rate > 1.2% over a rolling 6h -> create renewal_watch and CSM outreach within 18h. CSM checklist before reach-out: confirm keys, run streaming smoke, verify fallback model.

leo_csm: I'll draft kickoff email with a 1-question feedback poll: "How is latency vs expectation? (Good/Acceptable/Poor)" and expected volume table. Will post to #customer-comms for copy review. :+1:

tom_sre: On-call fallback quick steps: 1) set tenant_toggle.enable_streaming=false 2) set batch_size=1 3) switch to fallback_model=vega-lite 4) page if p95 > 1s for >10m. Add to eng-oncall doc.

rachel_te: Quick smoke curl for streaming handshake to include in onboarding script:
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"vega-v1","stream":true,"input":"ping"}' | jq .stream_open
```
Expect: true. Also run kv read/write for 5 sample keys under kv/vega/$TENANT.

deploy-bot: deploy: vega-onboard-runbook rolled to staging @ 2026-05-11T22:14:31Z - smoke tests passed.

anna_csm: Thanks team. Action items: leo send kickoff email + poll, rachel add curl + KV checks to onboarding script, tom update on-call runbook, jess add renewal_watch rule. I'll monitor first 24h telemetry and post any flags here. :eyes:
